description: Needs ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR: stream a sandbox file that may exceed 4 GiB — stream: true + zip64: true writes the Zip64 streaming layout (APPNOTE 4.3.9.2: a Zip64 extra in the local header, a 24-byte data descriptor) that every random-access extractor reads. Opt in only for entries that may cross 4 GiB: some streaming readers (Java's ZipInputStream) cannot read the speculative layout of a smaller entry. A file output above 4 GiB also needs the operator to raise ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_FILE_OUTPUT_BYTES.
